_comment: Issue #1097 (slow-motion tick-speed mode). One drill-mode Infantry unit marches south under a single move order; F5 is pressed three times mid-march to step through all three presets (100% -> 50% -> 25% -> 10%), each step visibly shrinking how far the unit advances over the same stretch of ticks. No enemy present -- drill: true is required here, not optional, since Battle._check_victory() would otherwise end the battle on the very first tick for having no team-1 units in play.
